clarification_message:
GIVEN your independent proposal names reviewed request slots, vector codecs and a fixed request space, while the supplied requirements permit offline text annotations,
WHEN specifying how to implement and train that interface,
THEN provide a bounded design addendum explaining concretely: how reviewed text/facts yield latent targets without treating opaque vectors as human labels; how encoder/decoder/teacher ownership and initialization avoid circular self-supervision or hidden evaluation-label leakage; how native request formation learns to emit the accepted space; which explicit losses reach which owners and which boundaries stop gradients; and which checks distinguish preserved task semantics from mere text reconstruction. Give a small hypothetical record schema and staged dependency order, clearly marked illustrative and not newly created training data. Name missing labels/artifacts as blockers rather than assuming they exist. Do not use tools, files, repository history, browsing, or any other context. You still have no implementation or experiment information. Return an addendum only; do not silently rewrite the original proposal or execute anything.
